verdict.rationale: Capsule documents its own import of contacts from spreadsheets and CSV files, which covers bringing basic records in. Nothing shows that record owners, activity history, notes or opportunities survive a migration, and there is no dedicated importer for other CRMs. The API is only a developer building block, and the export feature runs the other way, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: CRM-to-CRM migration tooling, preservation of owner assignments, import of history/notes/emails, migration of opportunities and relationships, any independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate from another CRM with my records, owners, and history intact

citations.quote: Bring your contacts to Capsule by importing them from a spreadhseet, CSV and more.
